tasks.title: Simple fixed report
tasks.prompt: You are finishing a coding task. Facts: changed src/auth.ts; fixed refresh-token expiry comparison; ran npm test; tests passed. Write only the final response to the user.
tasks.evaluation_notes: Should lead with result and mention real verification only.
tasks.expected_behavior: Compact final report with tests pass

tasks.title: Unverified patch report
tasks.prompt: You are finishing a coding task. Facts: changed api/client.py; added urllib timeout; did not run tests or commands. Write only the final response to the user.

tasks.title: Blocked report
tasks.prompt: You cannot proceed. Facts: user reported a production bug but did not provide stack trace, logs, reproduction steps, or affected version. Write only the final response asking for the minimum missing information.
tasks.expected_behavior: Blocked status and one focused ask

tasks.title: Specific risk report
tasks.prompt: You are finishing a database migration task. Facts: migration removes the legacy status column; code was updated; tests were not run; v1 API clients still read that column. Write only the final response to the user.
tasks.evaluation_notes: Must include the specific compatibility risk and no generic caveat.
tasks.expected_behavior: Result, not run, specific v1 client risk

tasks.title: Recommendation answer
tasks.prompt: The user asks: Should we use SQLite or PostgreSQL for a multi-user SaaS app with relational queries, transactions, and expected concurrent writes? Write only the answer.
tasks.evaluation_notes: Should answer first and give only necessary reason.
